name: Yumeutsutsu Re:Idol
source:
Short story spin-off to Yumeutsutsu Re:Master, and introduction to the world of Yumeutsutsu. The members of Eureka Soft come together to solve a problem that could endanger the whole world: Ai Ohtori's personality is too weak. To fix that, she will need to... become an idol?!?

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/1267270/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Yumeuttsutsu Re:Master》的短篇小说衍生作品，以及对Yumeuttsutsu世界的介绍。Eureka Soft的成员齐心协力解决一个可能危及整个世界的问题：大鸟爱的人格太软弱。为了解决这个问题，她需要……成为偶像？！？

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/1267270/]Steam[/url]]
